title: Asyncio Thread error when running Flow as Tool with a Agent
body:
### Bug Description

I'm trying to use the `Flow as Tool` component with an Agent. 

When the agent tries to call the Tool it throws an error: 

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2877b597-0787-4822-9a3d-1ccc7b5604d5)

The flow itself is simple and used to work in earlier versions. 

### Reproduction

Steps to reproduce: 

1. Load the flow that will be used as tool: [URL Search.json](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/16999269/URL.Search.json)
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c270d499-0935-4f2b-a9ab-baf48af8715c)

2. Load the agent flow: [Agent with Flow as Tool (simple) (1).json](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/16999336/Agent.with.Flow.as.Tool.simple.1.json)

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/35279b9c-cffd-428b-a0b3-70f6b15b1ebc)

3. In the `Flow as Tool` component, hit refresh and select the URL Search flow uploaded.

4. Ask the agent to open a URL, observe the error. 


### Expected behavior

Agents should be able to execute other flows as tool

### Who can help?

_No response_

### Operating System

ubuntu 22.4

### Langflow Version

1.0.18

### Python Version

None

### Screenshot

_No response_

### Flow File

_No response_

linked_prs.title: fix: refactor FlowTool to use run_until_complete for async flow execution
linked_prs.patch:
diff --git a/src/backend/base/langflow/base/tools/flow_tool.py b/src/backend/base/langflow/base/tools/flow_tool.py
index 298228b9c4e6..608c8234d87a 100644
--- a/src/backend/base/langflow/base/tools/flow_tool.py
+++ b/src/backend/base/langflow/base/tools/flow_tool.py
@@ -1,6 +1,5 @@
 from typing import Any, List, Optional, Type
 
-from asyncer import syncify
 from langchain_core.runnables import RunnableConfig
 from langchain_core.tools import BaseTool, ToolException
 from pydantic.v1 import BaseModel
@@ -9,6 +8,7 @@
 from langflow.graph.graph.base import Graph
 from langflow.graph.vertex.base import Vertex
 from langflow.helpers.flow import build_schema_from_inputs, get_arg_names, get_flow_inputs, run_flow
+from langflow.utils.async_helpers import run_until_complete
 
 
 class FlowTool(BaseTool):
@@ -49,10 +49,12 @@ def _run(
             )
         tweaks = {arg["component_name"]: kwargs[arg["arg_name"]] for arg in args_names}
 
-        run_outputs = syncify(run_flow, raise_sync_error=False)(
-            tweaks={key: {"input_value": value} for key, value in tweaks.items()},
-            flow_id=self.flow_id,
-            user_id=self.user_id,
+        run_outputs = run_until_complete(
+            run_flow(
+                tweaks={key: {"input_value": value} for key, value in tweaks.items()},
+                flow_id=self.flow_id,
+                user_id=self.user_id,
+            )
         )
         if not run_outputs:
             return "No output"
